test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "Deliceous."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'Delicious.'
 
• 'Delicious' means 'having a very pleasant taste or smell.' (बहुत ही सुखद स्वाद या गंध होना)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The newly opened restaurant’s fried chicken is very** delicious.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Deliceous' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's know the meaning of the other options:

 Meaning

 to improve or develop in skills, knowledge, etc. (कौशल, ज्ञान आदि में सुधार या विकास करना।)
